user_query: I'm researching the impact of weather conditions on supermarket sales. Can you provide me with data on supermarket sales in three different cities along with the corresponding weather conditions during that period? Additionally, I'm interested in the top IT certifications that are relevant to the retail industry.

TaskList.description: Collect supermarket sales data for the three specified cities.
Gather corresponding weather conditions data for the same cities and time period.
Analyze the collected sales and weather data to identify trends or correlations.
Research and identify the top IT certifications relevant to the retail industry.
